entries.7abdecd7043d6143: Based on its corporate philosophy of 'a company that is useful to society', the company pursues its business with the mission of providing customers with a 'bright, vigorous and harmonious' setting. Over the medium to long term, it states that it will work to strengthen the group's businesses overall, centered on the real estate business as its core business, while seeking to integrate new and existing businesses. For the buildings it owns, it states that it will raise the value of each building through more efficient operation and more detailed renewal, and that at the TOC Building, which has resumed operations, it will improve occupancy by using the building's characteristics, such as event and logistics functions.
